text:
emma: deploy-bot aborted staging publish for analytics-worker:pr-5102. finalize returned a different manifest than client computed.

deploy-bot: publish aborted: finalize_digest_mismatch. details:
  tag=staging-pr-5102
  computed=sha256:5d3a...
  finalize=sha256:7c9b...
  action=abort

marco: that "finalize != computed" smells like a mirror rewrite or proxy reassembly. any mirror jobs running?

infra: quick check: mirror-sync to gcr-eu started at 2025-10-22T08:12:50Z, mirror-proxy-3 logged a 502 burst at 08:12:51-08:12:54Z. S3 multipart uploads show retries from build-71. ticket INF-2052 opened.

claire: can we pin the rollout to the last good digest and republish from CI cache? prefer no rebuild.

deploy-bot: last_successful_digest for analytics-worker (staging) -> sha256:2f88... (2025-10-22T01:05:02Z)

emma: plan: (1) pin current deployment to sha256:2f88... (2) republish cached artifact ci-cache-9921 to a new tag staging-repub-9921 (no rebuild) (3) attach cosign + provenance and verify (4) re-run staging canary. release-manager, hold EU promote for this image?

release-manager: approve hold. update release notes: "analytics-worker staging publish held (manifest mismatch). republish in progress." remove from today's EU promote window.

marco: republish commands I'm running:
```
publishbot republish --artifact ci-cache-9921 --target-tag staging-repub-9921 --force
cosign verify --key kms://projects/redwood/keys/cosign service@staging-repub-9921
provenance verify --artifact staging-repub-9921 --require-attestation
```

infra: enabling finalize-stage checksum retry for this republish (3 attempts). also investigating mirror-proxy-3 autogenerated rotation on 502 bursts.

deploy-bot: republish started: ci-cache-9921 -> staging-repub-9921. watch: https://publishbot.internal/ops/9921

marco: cosign verify passed and attestation attached for staging-repub-9921 -> sha256:2f88...

deploy-bot: republish completed. staging-repub-9921 pinned to sha256:2f88...

claire: starting canary against staging-repub-9921. watching pulls and error rates now.

emma: if canary passes we'll manual promote outside EU window tomorrow morning. leaving the hold in release notes until then.

release-manager: canary green after 25m. ready for manual promote tomorrow. INF-2052 will track mirror-proxy fix and publishbot finalize retry enhancement. thanks team :thumbsup:
